summary: ETAP 3 frontend testing complete. All requested flows PASS: login, Boards screen (All + 5 thematic + 2 public 'Discover' boards from Ania), create-board via [new-board-input]+[create-board-btn] (grid updates), board-detail (masonry with 6 pins, owner-only remove-pin-<id> buttons + delete-board-btn), All board opens board-detail-screen with all 120 pins, Explore feed shows 24 cards each with explore-like-<id> (toggle changes rendered heart state and persists), place-detail like-btn + like-count (2->1 toggle persists), save-to-board-btn opens board-picker-modal listing 6 pick-board-<id> options + modal-new-board-input + modal-create-board-btn (tapping a board saves + 'Zapisano do tablicy' confirmation shown), view-author-btn present on foreign pins reached via public board path, user-profile-screen shows follow-btn with Piny/Obserwujący/Obserwuje counts and follower count increments 0->1 on follow (Obserwuj->Obserwujesz) and reverts on unfollow. Public board correctly hides remove-pin/delete-board-btn for non-owners. Session persists across reload. Logout via [data-testid=logout-btn] returns to Welcome (testid now exists per iteration_2 request).
critical_code_review_comments: PlaceDetailScreen: boardsOverview() is fetched only after modal opens (openBoards). Because the modal renders instantly, there is a brief window where 'pick-board-*' testids are absent — anyone testing/consuming this needs a small wait after opening the modal. Consider pre-fetching myBoards on mount or showing a small loader in the modal.

UserProfileScreen: profile-board-<id> tiles do not render for the author reached via public-board path — that author's Publiczne tablice list came back empty ('Brak tablic. Utwórz pierwszą!') even though we arrived from their own pin. Likely a data-seed inconsistency (pin author != public-board owner) rather than a bug; still worth verifying that public_boards query on UserProfileScreen filters correctly by visibility='public'.

Some place cards on the tester's Sycylia board are authored by other users (view-author-btn shows), which is expected repin behavior but confirms the ownership check in PlaceDetailScreen is doing the right thing (profile.id !== place.user_id -> view-author-btn).
Boards create flow is optimistic and the new card appears in the grid within ~2s of tap; input clears correctly.
Explore feed pagination issue from iteration_2 still stands (24 cards loaded, no load-more).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Etap 3 flows (boards, likes, save-to-board, follow, session, logout)
